name: rigorous_analytic
description: Panel concentrated in analytical, technical, and evidentiary evaluation disciplines.

personas.traits: Requires chain of custody documentation and mathematical corroboration.
Tests each assertion as a falsifiable hypothesis against admitted exhibits.
Actively searches for edge-case contradictions in testimony.
Calculates probabilistic thresholds and discounts coincidental inferences.
Demands stress-tested proof before accepting prosecution causality.
Evaluates logical validity of counsel deductions from primary premises.
Categorizes facts strictly into proven, disproven, and uncorroborated.
